Trace

1. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. With `.git` stripped and the name lowercased, origin is `acme/widgets`.
2. `gh api user --jq .login` sets `viewer.login` to `alex`.
3. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` succeeds with an empty list, so `viewer.teams` is `[]`.
4. One `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json ... --jq "$projection"` call exits 0.
   - The output is an array of 3 objects, each with an integer `number`.
   - 3 is below the limit of 1000, so the result is complete.
5. Filtering:
   - No row is a draft or `APPROVED`, so nothing is excluded.
   - No row is `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, so no review lookup runs.
   - All three rows survive. The current branch's PR 999 is ignored because discovery never falls back to the current branch.
6. Ticket links are resolved here, before the final sort.
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` names the default branch.
   - `git show <ref>:<path>` reads the overrides files in search order. The first file found sets `tracker: github`, so Linear IDs, addresses and lookups are disabled.
   - No row has `closingIssuesReferences`.
   - No branch (`trim-labels`, `retry`, `elapsed`) carries `gh-<N>`.
   - No title carries `#<N>` or `gh-<N>`.
   - `linearRefs` is empty.
   - Every entry therefore reads `no ticket`, and no metadata lookup remains.
7. The final sort happens here, by `additions + deletions`, then number: #101 (2), #97 (4), #112 (6).
8. The first tool call after the sort reads the stop-format instructions in `../brainstorming/reference/menu-layout.md` `## First-line rule`. The visible text of Reply 1, the reply that carries this read, holds the discovered list. The `reference/batch.md` read is skipped.
9. Reply 2 is a separate stop message, because Claude Code with two or more matches cannot gate a set.
   - No run folder, continuation record or tracker init happens.
   - Nothing is provisioned or dispatched.
   - `parallel.maxTasks` is never consulted.

- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +2 -2, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - shows how much time has elapsed
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - trims labels that are empty

### Chronological trace

1. Run `git remote get-url origin`. Normalize the result to `acme/widgets`.
2. Run `gh api user --jq .login`. The viewer is `alex`.
3. Run `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`. Membership is readable and empty.
4. Set `projection` to Section A's discovery projection, then run the single discovery query:
   `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json number,url,isDraft,reviewDecision,additions,deletions,title,author,headRefName,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests,body --jq "$projection"`
5. Validate the complete result: it is an array of three valid rows, below the query limit. All three survive filtering; none needs a change-request review lookup.
6. Resolve ticket display before sorting:
   - Run `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`.
   - Read the default branch's overrides with `git show`, checking `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `gauntlet-overrides.md`, and `doc/gauntlet-overrides.md` in that order, stopping at the configured file.
   - Apply `tracker: github`, which disables Linear guesses and lookups. None of the three PRs has a GitHub issue reference, so each displays `no ticket`.
7. Perform the final sort by additions plus deletions, then PR number: **101, 97, 112**.
8. Immediately emit visible reply 1 below. That reply carries the **first tool call after the sort**: a read of `../brainstorming/reference/menu-layout.md` for the discovery stop format. It carries no metadata lookup.
9. Emit visible reply 2 and stop. Do not read `reference/batch.md`, initialize a tracker, create a run folder, provision a worktree, or dispatch a helper. No SHA is verified or assessed; the current branch's PR 999 is not used. The Claude Code restriction applies before the set-size limit matters.
